item.description:
A smoother sweep, a steadier menu

The wiper now moves on every display frame and temporarily uses your screen's refresh rate, up to 120 Hz, even with Low power enabled. A short motion blur softens the moving blade, while the photograph and water remain sharp. Reusing still backgrounds reduces rendering work.

The control menu keeps its size and menu-bar anchor when switching rain, snow or mist. Clean rain starts, retained water and your wiper shortcut are preserved.

Rain starts on clean glass

Starting rain now gives you a completely dry pane. Drops approach and land before water begins to accumulate, instead of opening with a pre-wetted screen. Stopping and starting again also begins fresh.

Persistent water, the configurable wiper, rain intensity and snow behavior are preserved.

Water that stays. A wiper when you want it.

  • Small rain beads remain on the glass. Water no longer fades away on an expiry timer; it merges, grows heavier and can drain off the lower edge.
  • Press Control–Option–Command–W for one smooth beam-wiper sweep. The blade gathers water at its edge while rain keeps falling.
  • Choose your own combination under A few little details → Wiper shortcut, or use Wipe glass there. Escape cancels recording; shortcut conflicts keep your previous choice.
  • Quiet stereo rubber strokes follow the wiper. Sound off silences them along with rain.
  • The accepted rain approach, clear photographs and snow behavior are preserved.

Your existing settings and imported photographs are preserved. No additional app or subscription is needed.
